title: A record name composed of select option labels cannot render in the reader's locale — no option-label function in CEL, and the save toast and related lists show the raw or stored string
body:
Filing gate: ③ platform gap (consumer-blocking), measured in the browser on @objectstack 18.2.0 (hotclm `main` bc5c3e8, `pnpm demo:zh`, README-made personas, zh-CN and en-US).

**What is missing.** A record name made of select option labels cannot render in the reader's locale. hotclm composes four child names, such as `v2 · Clean`, `Legal · Legal Counsel 1` and `Wet ink · Completed`, into a stored `display_name` mirror (AGENTS.md: "stored display_name mirror … never a formula"). The stored string has one language, so a zh-CN reader sees English in every toast, related list, lookup and record H1, while every other word on the page is Chinese.

**Measured — every route the spec offers today:**
| route | zh-CN result |
|---|---|
| stored mirror (current) | toast 合同版本"v2 · Clean"已创建; H1 the same in zh-CN and en-US; REST search 清稿 = 0, Clean = 2 |
| formula `nameField` `'v' + string(record.version_no) + ' · ' + record.kind` | toast and H1 "v2 · clean" (raw value): CEL has no option-label function and never receives the locale |
| select field as `nameField` (`clm_signature.method`) | H1 湿签 / Wet ink is translated, but the toast reads `签署记录"wet_ink"已创建`; it also cannot compose two fields |
| `titleFormat: '{stage} · {reviewer}'` | no effect, because the registry auto-designates `display_name` as `nameField` (ADR-0079 D7); lint `title-format-retired` |

**Seams.**
- `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts`: there is no option-label function. `EvalContext.locale` (`types.ts`) is reserved for template formatters, and `template-engine.ts` FORMATTERS has no `label`.
- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts` `getRecordDisplayName` uses raw values, and the save toast (`app-shell` `AppContent.tsx` `recordSaveMessage`) calls it.
- `ui/packages/components/.../containers.tsx` `withOptionLabels` translates on the H1 only (objectui#13103).

**Expected.** A display-only record name made of option labels, for example a `label(record.kind)` function evaluated with the request locale, or a name template whose select placeholders render as labels. It renders in the reader's locale on the toast, related list, lookup, search result and H1, while a stored field stays available for search.

**Business reason.** A Chinese-speaking legal team reads English fragments on every save of a version, review or signing round. HotCRM and any app that names child rows by type and status hits the same wall.

**Consumer.** objectstack-ai/hotclm #157 (Blocked-by this card). Report: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotclm/issues/157#issuecomment-6439089136.

**Duplicate search.** objectstack issues, all states: "record title option label locale", "nameField formula select label translation", "getRecordDisplayName option label", "picklist label function CEL". Related, closed: #26452 (forms route options) and #22536 (page header). No duplicate.
